info.title: Shipmozo Shipping API
info.description:
REST API for order fulfillment, courier assignment, tracking, warehouses, NDR, and labels. All responses use `result` (`1` = success, `0` = failure), `message`, and `data`.

**Base URL:** `https://shipping-api.com/app/api/v1` — do not add a trailing slash.

**Auth:** Send `public-key` and `private-key` headers on every protected route, or obtain keys via `POST /login`.

**Rate limits:** Shipmozo returns `x-ratelimit-limit` (500) and `x-ratelimit-remaining` on each response. Quota is **500 requests per 1-minute window** per client IP address (not per API key); `remaining` drops with each call and **refreshes when the minute rolls over**.

**Support:** munish@apporio.in

rateLimitHeaders.title: Response headers (from live API / Swagger)
rateLimitHeaders.description: Shipmozo documents rate limits via response headers, not only in PDF copy. Read these on every call:

headers.name: x-ratelimit-limit
headers.meaning: Max requests allowed in the current 1-minute window per client IP address (not per API key)

headers.name: x-ratelimit-remaining
headers.meaning: Requests left in the current window — decreases by 1 on each API call you make. You only see a new number on the next HTTP response (the page does not auto-update). After ~60s without traffic, the next call usually shows remaining closer to 500 again (sliding window).

rateLimitHeaders.note: 498 in tutorials means '2 calls used this minute' — not a fixed cap. Use Overview → Check now to read current headers.

alreadyInStateNote.title: “Already in this state” can be a success
alreadyInStateNote.body: Several responses look like duplicates but return result: "1": Push Order → "Order is already scheduled"; Schedule Pickup → "Order is already scheduled"; Create Warehouse → "warehouse with same title already exists" (returns the existing warehouse_id). Checking only for result "0" will miss these. Assign Courier is not in this list — a second assign on an already-assigned order is blocked earlier and returns "Order id is not valid".

x-portal.rateLimitIpNote: The 500 requests/minute limit is enforced per client IP address, not per API key. If you run multiple API key pairs from behind the same network (e.g. an office NAT), they share one combined 500/min budget rather than 500 each.
x-portal.timezoneNote: API storage/app timezone is UTC. Most user-facing date/time fields are converted to IST (Asia/Kolkata) for display. expected_delivery_date is IST, date-only. Exception: Track Order scan_detail[].date is returned as the raw UTC string, not converted to IST.
x-portal.optionalFieldNote: When an optional field has nothing to provide, omit the field entirely or send null. Both are treated as “not provided” in most cases. Do not treat empty string "" as universally safe — some fields pass empty strings through rather than substituting a default.

getOrderDetail.summary: Get full details of an order
getOrderDetail.description: Returns the full order snapshot by Shipmozo internal order_id.
x-docNotes: shipping_details (awb_number, courier_company, lr_number, optionally child_awb_numbers) is populated only when order_status is PROCESS or SCHEDULED — otherwise it is [].
weight and volumetric_weight are returned in grams, not kg.
pickup_details shape differs by order type — forward orders pull from the warehouse; return orders pull pickup_* fields from the order.
For non-domestic orders, billing_* fields are literal copies of shipping_* — there is no separate billing address stored.
zone is typically a string, but the exact type is not fully confirmed for all order states (it may fall back to a richer object when no partner-zone relation is set).
